name: text-to-speech
description: Turn text into spoken audio with Deepgram. Use when someone asks for text-to-speech, TTS, speech synthesis, a synthetic voice, a voice for a voice agent, an IVR prompt, or an audio version of some text, and whenever they mention Aura, Aura-2, Flux TTS, /v1/speak or /v2/speak. Trigger phrases: "text to speech", "TTS", "speak endpoint", "generate speech", "synthesize audio", "read this aloud", "which Deepgram voice", "Aura vs Flux TTS", "TTS with barge-in". Gets an agent to a correct first request, then routes to the api, docs, starters, recipes, examples, setup-mcp and per-language SDK text-to-speech skills.
